title: Meshtastic portduino SimRadio bridge for Medium simulator
description:
Enable running Meshtastic in the LICHEN Medium simulator for comparative benchmarking.

Approach: Meshtastic native Linux build (portduino) with custom SimRadio backend.

Research:
- Meshtastic portduino radio abstraction (RadioLibInterface or similar)
- Their existing simulated radio implementation
- Required callbacks: TX, RX, CAD, channel/power config

Implementation:
1. Write a RadioInterface shim that opens TCP to Medium simulator
2. Map Meshtastic radio ops to our wire protocol (MSG_TX, MSG_RX_ENTER, etc.)
3. Handle position reporting (Meshtastic has GPS, need to feed x/y/z to Medium)
4. Package as a portduino platform variant or runtime flag

Testing:
- Single Meshtastic node TX/RX through Medium
- Two Meshtastic nodes talking via Medium
- Mixed topology: Meshtastic + LICHEN nodes in same Medium

Benchmark scenarios:
- 50 nodes, 10 concurrent conversations, measure delivery/latency
- Flood routing collision storms under load
- Channel utilization comparison

Depends on: project-LICHEN-worker6-bl2u (lora-medium extraction, or at minimum stable wire protocol)
